text_corrections.old: A search-result summary quoted about 99.99 % purity, about 77 % recovery, about 5.2 MJ/kg H2 and, for a four-layer bed at 35 bar, 99.97 % and 79 %. text_corrections.new: Full text read on 24 November 2026 (research/notes/abdoos2025_full_text.md; research/data/abdoos2025_extract.json). Simulation (Aspen Adsorption, ANN surrogate, NSGA-II), 4-bed 8-step zeolite 5A cycle, DRY NH3-FREE 75/25 H2/N2 feed (NH3 and H2O are not model components), adsorption 6-12 bar (optima 7.9-11.6 bar), 83-98 kmol/h feed; recovery surrogate scatter about 1-3 points at 72-78 % recovery (Fig. 13). No cyclic-PSA experiment. The SEC is feed compression from about 1 bar, not PSA own power. Correction of the earlier search summary: '99.99 %, 77 %, 5.2 MJ/kg' joins two different points (5.19 MJ/kg is the lowest SEC on the front, at about 91-96 % purity); 'four-layer bed at 35 bar, 99.97 % and 79 %' is the paper's citation of Moon et al. 2016 (syngas), not a result of this paper.
text_corrections.reason: Table 8 values entered; '5.2 MJ/kg' joined two points; '35 bar, 99.97 %, 79 %' is Moon et al. 2016 (syngas); SEC is feed compression

Candidates, all NOT entered: Mehr 2026 overall plant SEC 1.12 kWh/kg at 100 % load (the same paper elsewhere gives 7.5 and 13.6 kWh/kg for the compressor, so it is inconsistent); Abdoos 2025 (full text read 24 November 2026, see S07): its SEC of 6.4-8.76 MJ/kg (1.8-2.4 kWh/kg) at the Table 8 optima, and the abstract's 5.19 MJ/kg, are feed compression from about 1 bar to the adsorption pressure (reconstructed within 1-3 %), NOT a PSA own power, and do not transfer to the AmCraX 19.5 bar feed, which needs no feed compressor.
